scripts.migrate: if [ -z "$DIRECT_DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo 'Set DIRECT_DATABASE_URL to your Neon/Postgres direct connection string.' >&2; exit 1; fi; for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do psql "$DIRECT_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done
